title: Lamb of God (Agnus Dei)
text:
Lamb of God, you take away the sins of the world,
have mercy on us.

Lamb of God, you take away the sins of the world,
have mercy on us.

Lamb of God, you take away the sins of the world,
grant us peace.

translation.latin:
Agnus Dei, qui tollis peccata mundi,
miserere nobis.

Agnus Dei, qui tollis peccata mundi,
miserere nobis.

Agnus Dei, qui tollis peccata mundi,
dona nobis pacem.

attribution: Based on John 1:29, introduced by Pope Sergius I (7th century)
notes: The Agnus Dei is sung or recited during the breaking of the bread at Mass, just before Communion. It recalls John the Baptist's words when he saw Jesus: 'Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world.'
